title: A gallery card dropped on the agent chat attaches its 512 thumbnail, not the picture
description: Proven 2026-09-22: the file staged for the agent is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the card's `.thumb.webp`. `att_6ae33f4a.webp` (512x682) sha256-matches `Anime Kids and Dog/Media/.meta/998f15b2-....thumb.webp`, whose card t2i_003 is 768x1024 - and a second identical copy sits in that project's `.preview-assets/`, so the thumbnail went on to feed a real generation. Nothing in our code downscales: `saveAttachment` writes the posted bytes verbatim, and `MpiAgentChat._addImageFile` FileReaders the dropped File verbatim. The shrink is the DRAG. A card's `` is the 512 rendition `pickImageRendition` picks for an unpromoted card, and Chromium synthesises `dataTransfer.files` from that element's own resource - so a drop handler that reads `files` gets the thumbnail. The card's real `filePath` rides the same drag in `application/mpi-media` (set by MpiGalleryGrid dragstart); MpiPromptBox's `_handleMediaDrop` reads it first, MpiAgentChat's drop never did. The agent then edits the thumbnail and reports ok, at a quality loss nobody is told about. Follows MPI-877, which fixed only the MASKED case.
